body: Prospective memory means carrying out a deferred intention at the right future cue while other work continues. Benchmarks now isolate it as an agent skill, yet frontier LLMs still struggle: the best published PM-Bench scaffold reaches only 65.1% Set-F1. We argue that this loop is schema-constrained state tracking rather than open-ended reasoning, and that small models can execute it when the action space is typed. We propose the Prospective Intention Store (PIS) that puts lifecycle logic in code and scoped language work on the model. The scaffold is agentic and training-free: no selector fine-tuning and no trajectory distillation. On PM-Bench, DeepSeek-Chat with PIS reaches 82.9% Set-F1. On Gemma-E2B, Set-F1 is only 4.2% without a store and at most 6.6% under seven retrospective memories, while PIS reaches 66.2%. PIS further reaches 70.1% Set-F1, where retrospective memory methods stay at most 54.4%. PIS sets a new state of the art on this benchmark and enables small models to surpass the published large-model scaffold.
summaryZh: 本文针对智能体在预期记忆（Prospective Memory）任务中的表现瓶颈，提出了“预期意图存储”（PIS）架构。该方案通过将生命周期逻辑封装在代码中，将复杂的意图追踪任务转化为类型化的状态管理，从而使小模型（SLM）能够执行复杂的延迟意图任务。实验结果显示，在PM-Bench基准测试中，该方法使DeepSeek-Chat和Gemma-E2B等模型表现大幅提升，甚至超越了此前的大模型基准。该研究证明了通过架构设计而非单纯依赖模型规模，可以有效提升智能体的长期记忆与任务执行能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出了针对小模型智能体的预期记忆存储方案，显著提升了智能体在复杂任务中的表现，具有极高的技术创新性。

glossary.explanationZh: 预期记忆，指在未来特定时刻执行预定意图的能力。
小语言模型，指参数量较小、推理成本较低的模型。
预期意图存储，一种通过类型化存储管理智能体意图的架构方案。
用于评估集合匹配准确性的指标，常用于智能体任务完成度评估。
模式约束，指通过预定义的结构化规则限制模型行为。
